ablation.name: d9c_swd24_15ep
ablation.notes: D9c: Loss reweighting - extreme style. single_step_swd_weight 12->24 (+100%, 2x). Theory: D9a (+33%) and D9b (+67% with content down) test moderate pushes. D9c tests EXTREME style weight (2x baseline) to find the upper limit. If D9a/D9b show monotonic DINO-sty increase, D9c tests if we've hit diminishing returns. If D9a/D9b fail, D9c tests if extreme push can break ceiling. Grid: 12(baseline), 16(D9a), 20(D9b), 24(D9c) — well-separated values. bs=96.
